candidates.source_name: BQK — Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara (PDF register)

This is the master actor-map generator for the payments-employer landscape: every PSP/EMI/MTO legal entity that can legally hire in Kosovo appears here, and diffs between successive editions reveal new market entrants (i.e. new employers) before any hiring news appears.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic fetch of the dated PDF (URL pattern /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/Lista-e-institucioneve-financiare-DD.MM.YYYY-ALB.pdf); parse entity tables; diff vs prior snapshot to detect additions/removals. Note parent site returned 403 to a plain fetch, so use a browser-like agent.

negative_findings.description: No Kosovo-specific payments-industry trade press, PSP-only newsletter, or acquiring/processing trade association website was found. Payments-sector employer news is scattered across general news outlets, the banking association magazine and the FIKS cluster page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sq and en for payments-sector trade media returned only general news outlets and the Kosovo Banking Association magazine on Issuu.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without a trade-press spine, the cell must rely on aggregating many low-volume company channels, raising collection cost and the risk of missing leadership moves at small PSPs.

negative_findings.description: English-language searches for Kosovo acquiring/merchant-services vacancies were dominated by US job aggregators (ZipRecruiter, SimplyHired, Indeed) and employer-of-record marketing pages, with no genuine Kosovo payments vacancies.
negative_findings.result_summary: The query 'Kosovo payment service provider hiring acquiring merchant services jobs' returned zero Kosovo-domiciled payments vacancies; all hits were US-centric or EOR vendor content.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that English-only collection is structurally inadequate for this cell and that global aggregators must be excluded or heavily filtered to avoid polluting the signal set.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) coverage of the Kosovo payments-employer landscape is very thin. Searches using 'platni promet', 'usluge plaćanja', 'zapošljavanje', 'oglasi za posao' and 'Severna Mitrovica' produced no Kosovo-Serb payments employer, no local job portal, and no vacancy listings — only Belgrade press on the dinar payment-traffic dispute and unrelated Serbian job ads.
negative_findings.result_summary: One relevant sr article (Vreme, on the payment-traffic ban and NLB Komercijalna branch closures); no sr-language hiring source located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The run mandates sr coverage. A structural sr blind spot means payments-related job losses/creation in northern municipalities would be detected only through Albanian or English secondary reporting, with delay and bias.

negative_findings.description: Candidate local wallet/processor brand names probed speculatively ('Sendway', 'Klix', 'MPay') returned no evidence of being Kosovo payments operators. 'Rrota' resolved to a Kosovar creative/consulting company, not a payments firm.
negative_findings.result_summary: No corroboration found; these names are NOT recorded as payments actors.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated actor map. The verified non-bank payments actor set for Kosovo currently rests on Paysera, OneFor, Swinto, Numarics, Moneta, Unioni Financiar Prishtinë and PayLink (AL-registered).

negative_findings.description: The BQK licensed-institutions page returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on direct fetch.
negative_findings.result_summary: 403 on https://bqk-kos.org/mbikeqyrja-financiare/institucionet-financiare-te-licencuara-2/?lang=en; the site is clearly live (its PDFs are indexed and served).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most authoritative actor-map source needs a browser-grade fetcher. Recorded as bot-defended-but-live, NOT dead.

negative_findings.description: No public careers page was located for the bank-owned acquiring arms named in the cell brief (e.g. ProCredit or Raiffeisen acquiring/merchant-services units) as separate hiring entities. Their payments roles surface only inside the parent bank's postings on KosovaJob.
negative_findings.result_summary: Payments roles appear as bank departments ('Payments and Back Office Department'), not as distinct acquiring-arm employers.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means the cell's 'separate legal entity' premise holds for EMIs/MTOs/processors but not for bank acquiring in Kosovo; acquiring signals must be extracted from bank job ads by role-title matching (acquiring, POS, merchant, kartela, PCI).

coverage_gaps.description: No Serbian-language hiring or corporate source specific to payments employers operating in Kosovo was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sr-only scouting pass over Kosovo-Serb outlets (KoSSev, Kosovo Online, Radio Kim, Gracanica Online) and over Serbian job boards filtered for 'platni promet' and 'kartično poslovanje'; also check the Serbian NBS register for entities operating in northern Kosovo.

coverage_gaps.description: The full census of BQK-licensed non-bank payment and e-money institutions has not yet been enumerated — only the register's location was identified, not parsed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Parse the dated BQK licensed-institutions PDF to extract every IFJB / payment institution / e-money institution, then scout each entity's own careers page, social channels and ARBK record as first-class sources.

coverage_gaps.description: Recruitment intermediaries (headhunters, HR agencies, staffing firms) placing payments/fintech roles in Kosovo were not scouted, nor were university/bootcamp career portals that carry employer-branded intake programmes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout Kosovo HR/recruitment agencies and the career offices of UP, RIT Kosovo/AUK and UBT, plus STIKK (ICT association) member and job channels, for payments-employer demand signals.

coverage_gaps.description: Leadership-move evidence is currently thin: no systematic source of executive appointments at Kosovo payments firms was established beyond registry officer fields and ad-hoc news.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Establish a two-track leadership feed: (a) quarterly ARBK/OpenCorporates.al officer diffs for the payments watchlist, (b) analyst monitoring of company LinkedIn/Facebook plus The Kosovo Banker interviews. Treat FIKS governance changes as a proxy signal.

coverage_gaps.description: Several of the highest-value channels (LinkedIn company pages for Paysera Kosova, PayLink, Swinto; Facebook for OneFor) are login-walled and ToS-restrictive.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide a compliant access policy — licensed API, analyst-in-the-loop manual review, or exclusion — before building collection; do not scrape. Compensate by weighting company websites, job boards and registries more heavily.

brief: Kosovo's payments-employer landscape is small, young and split across three tiers: BQK-licensed non-bank institutions and e-money institutions (Paysera holding the reported first EMI licence, plus Moneta and the Western Union master agent Unioni Financiar Prishtinë with 170+ locations), diaspora-facing fintechs clustered in FIKS (OneFor, Swinto, Numarics), and regionally-registered card processors serving Kosovo banks (PayLink, Albanian-registered). Hiring signal is concentrated in Albanian-language job boards — KosovaJob is the anchor, with DuaPune, ShpalljePune, GjejPune and PunaIme as redundancy — while the authoritative actor map comes from the BQK licensed-institutions PDF register and ARBK, and leadership-move evidence must be reconstructed from registry officer changes, The Kosovo Banker magazine and company social channels. Contrary to the cell hypothesis, bank acquiring in Kosovo is not staffed through separate legal entities: those roles appear as bank departments (e.g. ProCredit's 'Payments and Back Office Department'), so acquiring signal requires role-title matching inside bank ads. The dominant weakness is Serbian-language coverage: no sr-language payments employer or vacancy source exists for northern Kosovo, leaving organisation-change events there (such as the reported NLB Komercijalna branch closures amid the dinar payment-traffic ban) visible only through Belgrade press.
